line.name: Flor de las Antillas Maduro
line.description: Maduro-wrapped expression of My Father's Flor de las Antillas line. Debuted April 2015 as a Federal Cigar retailer exclusive, then expanded to regular production by the November 2016 IPCPR trade show.
line.notes: Sourced from photos physically filed in the Mac's 'Flor de Selva Maduro' folder (under the separate 'Flor de Selva' top-level folder) - every filename in that folder is prefixed 'Flor_de_las_Antillas_Maduro_*', not 'Flor_de_Selva_*'. This appears to be a folder-naming/misfiling error on the Mac side; see README and image manifest.
